nodes.label: Transaction History (/console/transactions)
nodes.rationale: Ported from Eloka's History feature; columns are literal JSX and logic is plain functions because Eloka's 918-line historyParametersMetadata engine exists to serve views this page does not have.

nodes.label: Interaction 154 — transaction history upstream
nodes.rationale: Runs on its own host/port and an older API version — not the main upstream. Each URL part is an optional override falling back to the main upstream.

nodes.label: debitOf / creditOf money rules
nodes.rationale: Return 0 not "" — blanking an empty cell is the renderer's job; Eloka folds blanking into compute and then coerces numbers back out of strings downstream. A failed row (response_status_id 1) contributes 0 to both.

nodes.label: inferSearchField (quick-search shape heuristic)
nodes.rationale: The ranges overlap (a 10-digit input is both a valid mobile and a valid TID), so the order of the checks IS the spec — pinned by a boundary table test.

nodes.label: selectEvalueAccountId (E-value account resolution)
nodes.rationale: Omitting account_id makes upstream fall back to the default account — quietly reporting somebody else's history. Refusing with 502 NO_ACCOUNT is the honest answer. Negative synthetic ids (-500000 'Response Awaited') are always filtered out.

nodes.label: parseFilters allow-list (trust boundary)
nodes.rationale: Only known keys are copied out and shape-checked so no extra interaction field (org_id, interaction_type_id) can be smuggled upstream. Mirrors parseBusiness in signup.ts.

nodes.label: POST /transactions/search (POST, not GET)
nodes.rationale: Filters carry mobile numbers, account numbers, TIDs and amounts; a query string would put all of them into browser history, proxy logs, and this app's own access log.

nodes.label: SIMPLIBANK_HISTORY_* upstream override (eko.historyUrl)
nodes.rationale: Per-part overrides falling back to the main upstream so a deployment sharing one box only has to set the path; the history host runs the same plaintext-http guard.

nodes.label: Per-page totals / Closing Balance caveat
nodes.rationale: Upstream returns no grand totals, so the footer sums only on-screen rows and is labelled 'Totals for this page'. Real totals are an API change, not a UI one.

nodes.label: transactions.sample.ts (captured interaction-154 response)
nodes.rationale: A genuine captured response settles envelope shape, string coercions, absent amount fields, ISO-8601 +05:30 datetimes and pre-masked mobiles/accounts; mapTransactionRows is tested against it.
